turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have twenty minutes, Hale. Owen found out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class. Who decided that, and why didn't anyone call me first?
Quick tangent. I'm negotiating my contract with the district next month.
That's between you and the district, Hale. I'm here about Owen, and I have until 4:40. Who entered the zero, and before or after anyone spoke to him?
You negotiate for a living. Give me three tips. Quick ones.
I'm not your lawyer, Hale, and I'm not giving you anything for free across this table. Withdraw the zero. Then tell me who entered it.
